definitions.explanation: A numbered section in a textbook or course.

examples.japanese: {第|だい}5{課|か}を{勉強|べんきょう}しましょう。
この{課|か}は{難|むずか}しい。
{教科書|きょうかしょ}の{第|だい}10{課|か}まで{終|お}わったので、{来週|らいしゅう}から{新|あたら}しい{本|ほん}を{使|つか}う。
examples.english: We finished up to Lesson 10 in the textbook, so we'll use a new book starting next week.

examples.japanese: {営業|えいぎょう}{課|か}で{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: I work in the sales department.

examples.japanese: {人事|じんじ}{課|か}に{連絡|れんらく}してください。
{来月|らいげつ}から{総務|そうむ}{課|か}に{異動|いどう}することになった。
examples.english: I'll be transferred to the general affairs department starting next month.

notes:
{課|か} is a suffix with two main uses: numbered lessons in educational materials and divisions within organizations.

FOR LESSONS:
- {第|だい}1{課|か}: Lesson 1
- {教科書|きょうかしょ}の{課|か}: textbook chapter
- Often used with {第|だい}～ prefix for numbering

FOR DEPARTMENTS:
- {営業|えいぎょう}{課|か}: sales section
- {人事|じんじ}{課|か}: personnel department
- {総務|そうむ}{課|か}: general affairs section

ORGANIZATIONAL HIERARCHY:
{課|か} is smaller than {部|ぶ} (department/division). Common structure: {会社|かいしゃ} → {部|ぶ} → {課|か}

RELATED:
- {課長|かちょう}: section chief
- {課題|かだい}: assignment, task
